# eSDIva API map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_api_map.py — edit HEADER there, then `just api-map`. -->

Read this before opening any source file. It holds every public signature, its
one-line purpose and its `file:line`, so most questions need no source read at
all. Open source only for behaviour a signature can't show, and then jump straight
to the line given here. Units: public API in mm (`_mm`), internals SI.

## Where things live

| Module | Owns | Open it when |
|---|---|---|
| `emission/emission.py` | `Emission`: pressure field p(r,t) or \|P(r,fc)\| on a grid; method routing, excitation/IR, attenuation, soft baffle | field shape, units, time grid, method choice |
| `reception/base.py` | `ReceptionBase`: shared `sequence_rf`, `synthetic_aperture_rf`, `scan_focusline`, `show`, `t0` finalisation (lens sag), checkpointing | sequences, FMC, moving scatterers, `t0` |
| `reception/reception.py` | `Reception`: fast pulse-echo kernel, `pulse_echo_rf`, `method=None` temporal/spectral routing | single-shot RF, PSF, method choice |
| `reception/conventional.py` | `ReceptionConventional`: sampled-SIR FFT-convolution backend | temporal/fst/auto path internals |
| `hsir/sir_temporal.py` | sampled SIR h(t) (SDI/FST numba kernels), `place_twoway_rf` | SIR accuracy, float32 cumsum, echo placement |
| `hsir/sir_spectral.py` | closed-form SIR spectrum H(ω) per patch, fused two-way spectrum | spectral path, attenuation in reception |
| `hsir/sir_paired.py` | pedagogic two-way delta train (`ReceptionPaired`) | only for the paired method |
| `attenuation/attenuation.py` | causal power-law H_att(f), path distances | attenuation / dispersion |
| `transducers/base.py` | `TransducerBase`: lazy geometry, delays, apodization, IR, `transform`, `copy`, mesh | anything every probe shares |
| `transducers/{linear,matrix,circular,radial,custom,fieldii_compat}.py` | concrete probes and their geometry/apodization | one probe type's geometry |
| `transducers/saved_transducers.py` | `Domino` (128-el linear), `Zeus_Matrix` (55×55) | ready-made probes |
| `fields.py` | `Field`: move (4×4 mm), resample, add fields | posing/compounding volumes |
| `plotting/plotting2D.py` | Matplotlib slices, planes, transient animations | 2-D figures |
| `plotting/plotting3D.py` | one-call PyVista volume/slice figures | quick 3-D figure |
| `plotting/plotting_pyvista.py` + `pyvista_functions.py` | `add_*` scene builders (take `plotter=`, never `show()`), `create_*_mesh` | composing 3-D scenes |
| `plotting/export_utils.py` | screenshots, PyVista/Matplotlib movies | saving figures |
| `beamforming/das.py` | DAS scanline, general 3-D DAS (`das_volume`), RCA DAS, envelope | imaging from RF |
| `io/rf_dataset.py`, `io/hdf5.py` | checkpointed RF store, HDF5/USTB export | long runs, interchange |
| `utilities/` | phantoms, noise, grids, dB, time alignment, runtime estimate, brain atlas | helpers |

Deeper, by topic: `transducers.md`, `emission.md`, `reception.md`,
`visualization.md`, `physics.md`, `validation.md` (same folder). Physics ground
truth for maintainers: `.claude/rules/physics-context.md`. With a
`graphify-out/` folder, `graphify query "<question>"` scopes a source dive.

## Emission

### `Emission`

Compute emitted acoustic pressure fields (monochromatic or transient). `src/esdiva/emission/emission.py:56`

- `Emission(transducer, *, c=1540.0, rho=1.0, fs=100000000.0, alpha0=None, freq_power=1.0, excitation=None, transfer_function=None, monochromatic=False, fast_attenuation=True, method=None, verbose=True)` `src/esdiva/emission/emission.py:110`
  - `.set(name: str, value)` — Update a simulation parameter at runtime. `src/esdiva/emission/emission.py:180`
  - `.compute_deltak(field_points_mm, *, method='auto')` — Per-patch trapezoid width Δk (in samples) for every field point. `src/esdiva/emission/emission.py:260`
  - `.__call__(field_points_mm, *, method=None) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, dict]` — Compute the pressure field at given field points. `src/esdiva/emission/emission.py:449`


## Reception

### `Reception`

Compute pulse-echo RF from point scatterers (Jensen's SIR scattering model). `src/esdiva/reception/reception.py:93`

- `Reception(tx, rx, *, c=1540.0, rho=1.0, fs=100000000.0, alpha0=None, freq_power=1.0, excitation=None, method=None, n_depth_bins='auto', verbose=True)` `src/esdiva/reception/reception.py:163`
  - `.set(name, value)` — Update a parameter at runtime, then invalidate the conventional delegate. `src/esdiva/reception/reception.py:228`
  - `.pulse_echo_rf(scatterer_positions_mm, amplitudes=None, *, per_scatterer=False, downsampling=None, out_path=None, checkpoint_chunks=1)` — Pulse-echo RF from point scatterers. `src/esdiva/reception/reception.py:842`

### `ReceptionConventional`

Pulse-echo RF by direct two-way SIR convolution (Jensen's model). `src/esdiva/reception/conventional.py:59`

  - `.pulse_echo_rf(scatterer_positions_mm, amplitudes=None, *, per_scatterer=False, downsampling=None, out_path=None, checkpoint_chunks=1)` — Pulse-echo RF from point scatterers. `src/esdiva/reception/conventional.py:549`

## Transducers

### `TransducerBase`

Abstract base class for all transducer types. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:23`

- `TransducerBase() -> None` `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:54`
  - `.element_centers` (property) — 3-D element centre positions, shape ``(n_elements, 3)`` in metres.
  - `.elevation_lens_sag` (property) — SIGNED offset (m) of a cylindrical elevation lens surface at its centre.
  - `.sub_quad_verts` (property) — List of quad-vertex arrays ``(4, 3)`` for every patch, in metres.
  - `.sub_area` (property) — Patch area in m² (same for all patches in a uniform grid).
  - `.sub_el_idx` (property) — Element index for each patch; maps patch to parent element.
  - `.n_sub_patches` (property) — Total number of rectangular sub-patches across all elements.
  - `.sub_patch_frames` (property) — Per-patch rigid-body frames used by the SIR kernel.
  - `.apodization` (property) — Per-element apodization weights, shape ``(n_elements,)``.
  - `.delays` (property) — Per-element delays in seconds, shape ``(n_elements,)``.
  - `.tx_N_active` (property) — Number of elements with non-zero apodization.
  - `.impulse_response` (property) — Electromechanical impulse response of the transducer element.
  - `.baffle` (property) — Baffle around the aperture: ``"rigid"`` (default) or ``"soft"``.
  - `.excitation` (property) — Excitation pulse for this transducer.
  - `.compute_delays(focus_mm=None, *, angle_steering_deg=None, c: Optional[float] = None, inplace: bool = True, plot: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray` — Compute per-element time delays for electronic focusing or plane-wave steering. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:466`
  - `.compute_apodization(focus_mm=None, *, FoverD: Optional[float] = None, apodization_type: Optional[str] = None, plot: bool = False, inplace: bool = True) -> numpy.ndarray` — Return uniform full-aperture apodization (all ones). `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:573`
  - `.set_apodization(weights: numpy.ndarray) -> None` — Set per-element apodization weights directly. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:627`
  - `.set_delays(delays: numpy.ndarray) -> None` — Set per-element delays directly (normalised so minimum = 0). `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:637`
  - `.set_impulse_response(ir: Optional[numpy.ndarray]) -> None` — Set the transducers impulse response. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:648`
  - `.set_excitation(exc: Optional[numpy.ndarray]) -> None` — Set the transducers excitation pulse. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:659`
  - `.get_mesh() -> pyvista.core.pointset.PolyData` — Build a PyVista surface mesh of the transducer. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:670`
  - `.show(*, window_size: Tuple[int, int] = (800, 600), scalars: str = 'Apodization', notebook: bool = False, jupyter_backend: Optional[str] = None, colorbar_title: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> None` — Interactive 3-D visualisation of the transducer surface. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:687`
  - `.plot_apodization(apodization: Optional[numpy.ndarray] = None, *, figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (6, 5), ax=None)` — Plot apodization weights as a line/stem chart. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:766`
  - `.plot_delays(delays: Optional[numpy.ndarray] = None, *, figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (6, 5), ax=None)` — Plot per-element delays in microseconds. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:817`
  - `.plot_delays_apodization(figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (10, 4)) -> None` — Side-by-side delay and apodization plot. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:866`
  - `.transform(T_matrix) -> None` — Rigidly move the aperture in space (rotation then translation). `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:881`
  - `.clean() -> None` — Release cached geometry arrays to free memory. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:946`
  - `.copy() -> 'TransducerBase'` — Return a deep copy of this transducer, including all state and cached geometry. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:955`
  - `.get_state_dict() -> Dict[str, Any]` — Return a snapshot of the current apodization / delay state. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:966`
  - `.set_state_dict(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None` — Restore apodization / delay state from a dictionary. `src/esdiva/transducers/base.py:981`

## Moving / compounding fields

### `Field`

A scalar volume (pressure, PSF, envelope, ...) that can be moved, drawn and combined. `src/esdiva/fields.py:42`

- `Field(data, coords, *, scalars='Pressure')` `src/esdiva/fields.py:63`
  - `.transform(matrix) -> 'Field'` — Rigidly move the field (the same 4x4 you pass the transducer). `src/esdiva/fields.py:118`
  - `.to_mesh(*, time_index=None)` — Build the posed PyVista mesh. `src/esdiva/fields.py:142`
  - `.add_to(plotter, *, time_index=None, **kwargs)` — Draw into an existing plotter (the overlay path; caller shows last). `src/esdiva/fields.py:173`
  - `.plot(*, time_index=None, show=True, **kwargs)` — Render on a fresh plotter (the one-shot path). `src/esdiva/fields.py:194`
  - `.resample(onto) -> 'Field'` — Sample this field onto ``onto``'s grid (zero where it does not reach). `src/esdiva/fields.py:218`

- `das_rca_volume(rf: 'npt.NDArray[np.floating]', coords: 'dict', *, angles_deg, tx_centers_mm, rx_centers_mm, rx_length_mm: 'float', grid_mm: 'dict', c: 'float' = 1540.0, fnum: 'float' = 1.0, rx_apodization: 'str' = 'hann', t_offset_s: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float32], dict]'` — 3-D delay-and-sum for a row-column (RCA) plane-wave sequence. `src/esdiva/beamforming/das.py:151`
- `das_volume(rf: 'npt.NDArray[np.floating]', coords: 'dict', tx_events: 'list[dict]', transducer, grid_mm: 'dict', *, c: 'float' = 1540.0, fnum: 'float' = 1.0, rx_apodization: 'str' = 'hann', t_offset_s: 'float' = 0.0, coherence_weight: 'bool' = False) -> 'tuple[npt.NDArray[np.float32], dict]'` — 3-D delay-and-sum for any transmission basis (TX aperture = RX aperture). `src/esdiva/beamforming/das.py:391`

## RF storage and export

### `RFDataset`

Resumable folder of per-event RF files with a JSON contents file. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:90`

- `RFDataset(path, config: 'dict | None' = None, *, meta: 'dict | None' = None)` `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:116`
  - `.meta` (property) — Free-form info stored at creation.
  - `.completed` (property) — Sorted indices of events whose file exists and is recorded done.
  - `.write_event(idx: 'int', rf, t0: 'float', dt: 'float', **info) -> 'None'` — Atomically store one TX event's RF and mark it completed. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:189`
  - `.read_event(idx: 'int', *, verify: 'bool' = False)` — Load one event's RF. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:230`
  - `.load_all()` — Assemble all completed events into the `sequence_rf` return format. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:265`
  - `.to_hdf5(path, *, probe_geometry_mm=None, sound_speed: 'float' = 1540.0)` — Export the whole dataset to one interchange HDF5 file. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:340`
  - `.summary() -> 'str'` — Human-readable status table (also returned as a string). `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:375`

- `config_fingerprint(config: 'dict') -> 'dict'` — Flatten a configuration dict into comparable strings. `src/esdiva/io/rf_dataset.py:34`
- `save_rf_hdf5(path, rf: 'npt.NDArray[np.floating]', coords: 'dict', *, probe_geometry_mm: 'npt.NDArray[np.floating] | None' = None, sound_speed: 'float' = 1540.0, meta: 'dict | None' = None) -> 'Path'` — Write per-channel RF and its timing to a single HDF5 file. `src/esdiva/io/hdf5.py:23`

## Utilities

- `align_to_common_time(fields_and_coords, *, align_to_shorter=False)` — Interpolate multiple transient fields to a common time grid. `src/esdiva/utilities/helper_functions.py:671`
- `estimate_sequence_runtime(sim, points_mm, n_emissions, *, probe_fractions=(0.05, 0.15), amplitudes=None, verbose=True)` — Project the wall time of a planned run, measured on this machine. `src/esdiva/utilities/benchmark.py:38`
- `add_noise(rf, snr_db, *, reference=None, rng=None)` — Add white Gaussian receiver noise at a given channel SNR. `src/esdiva/utilities/noise.py:15`
- `rf_rms(rf)` — RMS amplitude of an RF array — the reference `add_noise` quotes SNR against. `src/esdiva/utilities/noise.py:75`
- `to_dB(matrix, *, vmin=None, vmax=None)` — Convert a matrix to decibel (dB) scale. `src/esdiva/utilities/helper_functions.py:632`
- `compute_sub_elem_attributes(transducer)` — Flatten transducer patch geometry into arrays required by the SIR kernel. `src/esdiva/utilities/helper_functions.py:244`
- `create_spatial_grid_from_dict(simulation_struct)` — Create a simulation mesh for the ultrasound field. `src/esdiva/utilities/helper_functions.py:312`
- `make_phantom(extents_mm, n_scatterers, echogenicity_map=None, seed=None)` — Random scatterer cloud for a speckle phantom. `src/esdiva/utilities/phantom.py:7`
- `subdivide_cartesian(surface_fn: 'Callable[[float, float], np.ndarray]', u_range: 'Tuple[float, float]', v_range: 'Tuple[float, float]', n_u: 'int', n_v: 'int', *, inside_fn: 'Optional[Callable[[float, float], bool]]' = None, accept_fn: 'Optional[Callable[[float, float], bool]]' = None, border_refine: 'int' = 3, normal_sign: 'float' = 1.0, normalize_patch_size: 'bool' = False, max_shear_deg: 'float' = 5.0) -> 'dict'` — Tile a C1 surface on a cartesian (u, v) grid with flat rectangular patches. `src/esdiva/utilities/surface_subdivision.py:216`
- `subdivide_radial(sag: 'Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray]', radius: 'float', n_rings: 'int', *, normal_sign: 'float' = 1.0, ratio_big_patches: 'float' = 0.8, refine_factor: 'int' = 3, max_ring_turn_deg: 'float' = 15.0) -> 'dict'` — Tile an axisymmetric surface ``z(r)`` with flat rectangular patches. `src/esdiva/utilities/surface_subdivision.py:74`
- `reshape_to_mapped_points(x, y, z, flattened_volume)` — Reshape the flat SIR output to ``(Nt_or_1, Nx, Ny, Nz)`` layout. `src/esdiva/utilities/helper_functions.py:507`
- `explore_mat(obj, name='root', depth=0, max_depth=3)` — Print the hierarchical structure of a MATLAB .mat object. `src/esdiva/utilities/matlab.py:56`
- `mat_struct_fields(ms)` — Return field names from a MATLAB struct-like object. `src/esdiva/utilities/matlab.py:6`
- `mat_struct_to_dict(ms)` — Convert a MATLAB struct recursively to a Python dict. `src/esdiva/utilities/matlab.py:26`
